description: Fetch one Gmail message by id: the key headers (from/to/cc/subject/date), the plain-text body, a short snippet, and attachment metadata (attachment_id/name/mime/size — not the attachment bytes). Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the message content arrives via a follow-up message once the fetch completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Read a single Gmail message's content by its message id as a background job. Completion delivers parsed headers, the decoded plain-text body, a preview snippet, and attachment descriptors (id, filename, mime type, size) without downloading attachment bytes. Use after gmail_list_messages. The body is sensitive content. Fails gsuite.not_found if the id does not exist.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the message fetch; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to fetch one Gmail message by id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: no message id supplied, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass a valid 'id' from gmail_list_messages. gsuite.not_found: the message may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
